name: Rell
title: the Iron Maiden

Q.name: Shattering Strike
Q.description: Rell thrusts her lance, Stunning targets for 0.65 seconds, destroying all Shields, and dealing 60/100/140/180/220 + 0.6×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

W.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
W.description: Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed while mounted. Active - Ferromancy: Crash Down: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountDamage@ magic damage. Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:Shield@ Shield, which lasts until she remounts. Rell then enters her armored form, gaining @spell.RellW_Dismount:ResistanceIncrease*100@% increased Armor and Magic Resist, @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedASBoost*100@% Attack Speed and @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedRangeBoost@ Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use Ferromancy: Mount Up.
W.summary: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed. Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

E.name: Full Tilt
E.description: Rell and an ally charge, gaining 15% Move Speed, increased to 30% when facing enemy champions or each other for 3 seconds. Rell's next Attack or Shattering Strike explodes in an area for 0.05/0.055/0.06/0.065/0.07 + 0.0×AP max Health magic damage.
E.summary: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed. Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.

R.name: Magnet Storm
R.description: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies towards herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies towards herself and deals (75/125/175 + 0.55×AP) × 2 magic damage over the next 2 seconds.
R.summary: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

Passive.name: Break the Mold
Passive.description: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.
Passive.summary: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Engage tank support who knocks up with W dismount and drags enemies in with R. Wins fights by locking several champions down and stealing their resistances.
strengths: W dismount knock-up and R drag: very strong engage
Passive steals armor and magic resist
E move speed brings her ADC in with her
weaknesses: Engage-dependent: weak once W is down

curve.lvl3: strong – W + Q + E: engage with her ADC

profile.curveNote: Engages with W + Q at level 2.

Passive.notes: Attacks and abilities steal armor and magic resist.

W.notes: Mounted: dismount crash knock-up + shield. Dismounted: re-forms her mount.

E.notes: Move speed for her and an ally; next attack explodes.

R.notes: Pulls enemies in, then keeps dragging them toward her.

profile.windowAgainst: W down (no engage) or while dismounted and slow.
checks: W mounted form: confirm any dash/knock-up on re-mount.
